title: Structurally undefined high-band peak-frequency policy
timing: After formal feature extraction and its method-agnostic completeness audit, but before comparative inferential analysis, calibration, transform ranking, qualification decisions, validity-domain construction, or confirmation-outcome access.

scope.structural_undefined_rule: The peak frequency is structurally undefined exactly when high_band_energy_fraction is 0.0 and no transform component exists above 125 Hz.

primary_analysis.estimand: All-record physical-property qualification over the complete frozen formal-repeatability denominator.
primary_analysis.undefined_frequency_treatment: A structurally undefined primary frequency estimate is a record-level qualification failure for frequency estimation.
primary_analysis.denominator_rule: Retain every expected record in the primary qualification denominator.

availability_analysis.reporting: Report counts, proportions, and cluster-aware uncertainty by transform, disturbance stratum, SNR, property level, and phase.
availability_analysis.role: Required supportive analysis; it does not replace the all-record primary qualification result.

conditional_accuracy_analysis.population: Records with a finite high-band peak-frequency estimate.
conditional_accuracy_analysis.label: Accuracy conditional on the transform producing a high-band component.
conditional_accuracy_analysis.role: Secondary and explicitly conditional; it cannot be presented as unconditional transform performance.

qualification_and_validity_domain.other_primary_mappings: Impulsive-transient amplitude and notching depth use high_band_energy_fraction; their primary estimates remain defined when the fraction is zero.
qualification_and_validity_domain.conditional_qualification: Permitted only when a physically interpretable validity domain is derived from development-design variables, frozen before confirmation access, and tested unchanged on confirmation data.

firewall: Confirmation outcomes remain sealed and may not be accessed until this policy, calibration models, qualification rules, thresholds, and validity domains are frozen and externally registered as required.
hash_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with policy_sha256 set to null
